d: Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.
Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
q: 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

d: Alomar Holding Company is a leading Saudi-based diversified holding group specializing in real estate development and property management. As part of our ongoing growth in Riyadh, we are seeking a Site Project Manager to oversee the execution of residential construction projects, ensuring delivery to the highest standards.

This role is pivotal in managing all aspects of site operations, from early construction phases through handover and closeout. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and within budget.
q: 8+ years of construction/project management experience, including at least 3 years in a site leadership role such as Project Manager or Site Project Manager
Extensive contractor-side residential construction experience managing projects from early construction through handover (villas, townhouses, apartments, compounds)
On-site execution experience across civil, structural, architectural, and finishing/fit-out works on residential projects
Strong proficiency with Primavera P6 and/or MS Project
Experience managing construction execution using project schedules, lookahead planning, quality control procedures, inspection workflows, subcontractor coordination, and handover processes

Experience coordinating MEP interface activities with MEP teams/subcontractors and collaborating with consultants and developer/client representatives for inspections, approvals, RFIs, NCRs, and site instructions
Ability to work full-time on construction sites, conduct regular site inspections, and participate in progress walks and coordination meetings
Saudi Council of Engineers registration (or eligibility to register/transfer classification)
Eligibility to work in Saudi Arabia
Experience producing progress reports, lookahead plans, tracking delays, and implementing recovery actions on construction projects
Experience in the Riyadh or Saudi market
Ability to start within 30 days (notice period ≤30 days)
r: Managing daily on-site execution of residential construction projects from initiation to final delivery and closeout.
Leading and supervising site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and labor to ensure smooth operations.
Coordinating civil, structural, architectural, finishing, fit-out, and MEP interface activities.
Collaborating with consultants and client representatives, overseeing inspections, approvals, RFIs, NCRs, and site instructions.
Controlling progress, quality, safety, procurement, and documentation to meet approved specifications, budget, and schedule.
Reviewing and managing drawings, specifications, BOQs, schedules, method statements, material submittals, and inspection requests.
Preparing progress reports, lookahead schedules, site updates, and management reports; identifying delays and implementing recovery plans.
Supporting payment applications, quantity verification, variation orders, and claims in coordination with QS/cost control teams.
Leading snagging/de-snagging, testing/commissioning coordination, handover documentation, and closeout processes.
x: Paid annual leave and public holidays
On-site support and resources for project management
Opportunities for advancement within a leading Saudi investment group
